channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: How Bridging Funds Can Make Crypto Usable as Collateral
item.description: Bridging can put crypto on the chain where a lending market accepts it, but the token, bridge design and debt rules decide whether it works and at what cost.

item.title: How to fund a Mantle NFT mint
item.description: To mint an NFT on Mantle, move the right token to the network, keep MNT for fees and check that the funds arrived before you connect to the mint.

item.title: Three Ways to Recover a Bridge When Gas Runs Low
item.description: When a bridge stalls because gas runs low, first find which step is stuck, then top up, speed up a pending transaction, or use the bridge’s recovery path.

item.title: Compare the Route, Not Just the Cross-Chain Quote
item.description: A cross-chain quote is more than its output number: compare fees, route steps, timing, and what arrives on the destination chain before you approve.

item.title: How businesses should track cross-chain crypto transfers
item.description: A cross-chain transfer can split records across ledgers. Businesses need one joined trail showing ownership, value, fees and each step of the transfer.

item.title: Starknet asks holders to study an independent post-quantum chain
item.description: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to study an independent, post-quantum Layer 1, a move that could give it more control over security work tied to Ethereum.

item.title: When One Cross-Chain Swap Route Beats Two
item.description: A cross-chain swap can bundle a bridge and a trade into one route, but splitting the steps may give better control, clearer costs and fewer surprises.

item.title: How to turn bridged funds into native gas
item.description: Bridged tokens can arrive without the destination chain’s gas coin. Learn when to swap locally, bridge gas directly, and check fees before you send.

item.title: How to Reconcile a Crypto Treasury Across Chains
item.description: Cross-chain treasury reconciliation matches balances, transfers, fees and pending funds across networks, giving teams one clear view of what they hold.

item.title: How to Buy Protocol Cover With Mantle Bridge Funds
item.description: Mantle funds can support protocol cover, but the purchase may need to happen on Ethereum. Learn what to bridge, what cover protects, and what to check.

item.title: Estimate your cross-chain swap payout before you send
item.description: A cross-chain swap quote is a forecast, not a promise. Learn how pool depth, chain fees and price movement shape the amount that reaches your destination wallet.

item.title: How to use Relay Bridge for a launch sale
item.description: Relay can move sale funds to the required chain, but the token and network must match the sale page. Check the quote and confirm receipt before buying.

item.title: Why Bridge Refunds and Failed Transfers Can Cost Extra
item.description: A stalled bridge transfer can cost more than one fee: the original send, a retry or refund, and destination processing may each use separate transactions.

item.title: How to Keep Small Cross-Chain Swaps Efficient
item.description: Small cross-chain swaps work best when you compare the full route cost, group transfers where possible, and leave enough gas on both chains to finish safely.

item.title: Why a One-Flow Swap Can Help With Business Transfers
item.description: A one-flow swap can simplify a business crypto transfer, but teams still need to check the route, fees, timing, custody and records before using it for payments.

item.title: EBA puts USDC under joint EU and French supervision
item.description: The EBA has made USDC the EU’s first significant e-money token, shifting oversight of its reserves and liquidity to EU level from 12 November.

item.title: Is a Super Bridge Transfer Custodial or Noncustodial?
item.description: A bridge transfer is noncustodial only when you keep control of the assets; check who holds funds and can move them before you approve it on the destination chain.

item.title: Biswap routes: where a stalled transfer can pause
item.description: A stalled cross-chain transfer can pause before confirmation, during the bridge, or after arrival; tracing each stage shows what to check before retrying.

item.title: Ripple and Privy bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
item.description: Ripple and Stripe-owned Privy are adding embedded wallets to the XRP Ledger, letting apps support XRP and RLUSD payments without users managing keys.

item.title: Standard Chartered starts RLUSD custody on XRP Ledger
item.description: Standard Chartered now holds Ripple’s RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutions, while a planned LMAX link could let clients use tokens as trading collateral.
